area: the Claude skills and the pilot art tooling
summary: The /pilot-creator skill (new in this pull request) is rewritten round the scenes: the scene is now the procedure and the avatar is the scene's close-up, the bust procedure moved to references/BUSTS.md, and the skill gained the one-creature rules, the two painters and painting from the game's own frames. Tools/Build/pilot_art/refs.py lets a patch show the pilot's bust to the painter (bust=). CLAUDE.md's pilots line now names the scenes, refs.py and the one-creature rule.
why: Garrett's decision of 2026-11-11 (the scene close-ups replace the busts as avatars, each pilot a bespoke scene) and his notes that a pilot must be designed as one creature and painted from the game's own frames. Nothing outside the pilot art kit changed; the scene_sweep.js edit is a cost comment only.
